{{Quote|Master Tanis, Commander Flybane, stay close.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Holocomm" />}}
'''Tanis''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Holocomm" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 24: Toydaria">{{FactFile2014|24|22 BBY 85-86|The Struggle for Toydaria}}</ref> Tanis [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|fought]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] alongside [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. While Skywalker was making a [[Hologram/Legends|holorecord]] in which he requested aid from the Republic, he was spotted by a Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]]. Skywalker attacked the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], advising Tanis and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Flybane]] to stay close.<ref name="Holocomm" /> The battle was eventually won by the Republic.<ref name="RH">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Master Tanis was mentioned on the official [[LucasArts]] website, in a [http://www.lucasarts.com/games/jointheclonewars/holocomm.html?message_id=2&cam_requested=false holorecord made by Anakin Skywalker] on [[September 14]], [[2009]]. Although the record served as promotional material for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'',<ref name="Holocomm" /> Tanis did not appear in the finished product.<ref name="RH" />
